name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Super Sour Diesel
description: Super Sour Diesel is a strain renowned for its strong and pungent flavor profile. It offers an intense combination of diesel fuel and citrusy sourness, creating a unique and memorable taste. This strain delivers an energetic and uplifting high, stimulating creativity and focus. If you're looking for a strain that packs a punch in both flavor and effects, Super Sour Diesel is an excellent option.
